seo.title: About Oceans Alive Foundation
seo.description: Twenty years of community-led marine conservation on the Kenyan coast. Our story, mission, team, partners, and recognition.

CHAPTERS.title: Our Story
CHAPTERS.subtitle: From 30 hectares to a national blueprint
CHAPTERS.body: How a handful of Kuruwitu fishermen and a founder with a vision created Kenya's first marine sanctuary - and two decades later, a globally recognised conservation model.

CHAPTERS.title: Mission & Vision
CHAPTERS.subtitle: Purpose-driven, community-led
CHAPTERS.body: Our core mission, four guiding principles, and the values that drive every programme from reef to policy table.

CHAPTERS.title: Recognition
CHAPTERS.subtitle: Global impact, local roots
CHAPTERS.body: UNDP Equator Prize · King Charles III · IUCN World Congress 2025. Every award reflects the communities who earned it.

CHAPTERS.title: Our Partners
CHAPTERS.subtitle: Stronger together for the ocean
CHAPTERS.body: Coral Guardian, Canon CENA, UK FCDO, UNDP, IUCN - a global network of organisations aligned around one shared mission.

CHAPTERS.title: Our Team
CHAPTERS.subtitle: The people behind the work
CHAPTERS.body: From reef monitors to policy advocates - meet the core team and 7,000+ community stewards driving daily change in Kilifi County.

hero.label: ABOUT
hero.text: Oceans Alive is a marine conservation organisation working along Kenya's coast to restore ocean ecosystems, strengthen local livelihoods and support community-led stewardship of marine resources.
hero.text2: For more than three decades, members of our team have worked alongside fishing communities, Beach Management Units, women's groups and local institutions to develop practical solutions that benefit both people and the environment.
